task_definition.task_name: AR Picker P and S Arrival

task_description.overview: Estimate P and S arrival times using an autoregressive Akaike Information Criterion method combined with STA/LTA.
steps: Load three-component waveform data arrays for vertical (Z), north (N), and east (E).
Call ar_pick(z_data, n_data, e_data, sampling_rate, f1, f2, lta_p, sta_s, lta_s, a, b, c, d).
Receive P and S pick times in seconds.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Given three-component arrays {z_data}, {n_data}, {e_data} sampled at {sampling_rate} Hz, run ar_pick with parameters f1={f1}, f2={f2}, lta_p={lta_p}, sta_s={sta_s}, lta_s={lta_s}, and other params. Return P and S arrival times in seconds. Plot a figure to show the waveform, and the finally picked p and s arrival times. Save the pick time to {pick_time.save_name} with content {pick_time.content} and the plot to {pick_plot}.
